positioning.statement: GIR is restrained and editorial — charcoal cube, a single gold strata, serif headlines on ivory. A private‑office aesthetic where authority is understated and weighed in paragraphs, not pitched in decks.
differentiators: TIGR framework (Time, Investment, Goal, Result) · active portfolio support.

pad.title: Capital with conviction
pad.body: GIR invests where technology infrastructure meets underserved markets. We don't chase trends — we identify structural gaps and deploy capital into ventures built to own them. Our edge is proximity: every investment is embedded in the CodeLoop Ecosystem, giving portfolio companies operational support, distribution, and cross-portfolio leverage from day one.
pad.quote: The highest-returning capital goes where few dare to look and even fewer know how to build.
